title: Prepayment and Deposit Terms of the Hotel Rate Plans Range
content:
Every plan in the Hotel Rate Plans range is contracted either as a prepaid plan, whose share of the room total is taken at booking, or as a deposit plan, whose guarantee is expressed in room nights.

| Rate plan | Whole stay taken at booking | Share of room total taken at booking | Deposit, room nights |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | yes | 100 percent | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | yes | 100 percent | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | no | 25 percent | 1 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | no | 0 percent | 1 |
| Member Flex Rate | no | 0 percent | 1 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | no | 0 percent | 2 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | yes | 100 percent | 0 |

**Terms of the columns.** The first column records whether the whole stay is taken at booking rather than at the property. The second records the percentage of the room total taken at booking. The third records the number of room nights taken as a deposit where no full prepayment is required.

**Points of judgement.** *A guest books the Standard Flexible Rate and asks what is taken from the card at booking.* That plan is not a prepaid plan and its share of the room total is 0 percent; its guarantee is a deposit of 1 room night. *A guest books the Suite Flexible Rate for two rooms.* The plan's deposit figure is 2 room nights, the largest in the range; it is still a deposit plan and not a prepaid one. *A guest books the All-Inclusive Flex Rate.* That plan is prepaid in full at 100 percent, and its deposit figure is accordingly 0 room nights.
